daemon_url.label: Daemon URL
daemon_url.description: WebSocket address of the MagicPodsCore daemon (default ws://127.0.0.1:2020).

python_path.label: Python path
python_path.description: Absolute path to a Python 3 interpreter. Leave empty to use python3 from PATH (needed on NixOS/immutable distros where the session PATH may lack it).

battery_source.label: Bar battery source
battery_source.description: Which battery level the bar widget shows.

hide_when_disconnected.label: Hide when disconnected
hide_when_disconnected.description: Hide the bar widget when no supported headphones are connected.

show_label.label: Show battery label
show_label.description: Show the battery percentage next to the icon on a horizontal bar.
